statement: An ordinary filing says nothing. offload speaks only when they would not otherwise know: it could not read the dump, it could not do part of it, something is waiting on somebody else, or it decided something unexpected like starting a thread. It never claims what it did not do and never explains what it declined.
why: Their own message wears a Done mark and a link to every thread written to, so a sentence repeating that says it twice. A reply that names a thread nothing went into is the one untruth this surface must never produce.
sources: 004 AC-15 (partial success describes only what succeeded)
013: offload's own words are a record
